The Artist

Every set starts as a sketch before it ever touches a nail.

Nandini hand-paints each design freehand — linework, fills, and fine detail — before sealing it under a glass-glossy topcoat. Nothing is a printed decal; every swirl and letter is drawn to order.

Sets are made to fit your own hands, worn as press-ons or applied in-studio, and built around whatever story you want your nails to tell that week.
